'''Yerej''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Tungra sector/Legends|Tungra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A [[Battle of Yerej|space battle]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place near the planet during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF" />
